options.A: Eli had approximately 15 ounces of wax when he began to make the candles.
options.B: Eli used approximately 15 ounces of wax for each candle.
options.C: Eli had approximately 60 ounces of wax when he began to make the candles.
options.D: Eli used approximately 60 ounces of wax for each candle.
